CareerDetail1.title: Event Planner
CareerDetail1.description: We are looking for a creative and organized Event Planner to join our dynamic team at Viventro. You will be responsible for planning and executing unforgettable events that leave a lasting impression on our clients and their guests.
CareerDetail1.jobDescription: As an Event Planner, you will manage events from concept to completion while ensuring every detail aligns with our client's vision and expectations.
responsibilities: Understand client requirements and propose creative event concepts.
Plan and coordinate all elements of events including venue, décor, catering, entertainment, and logistics.
Manage budgets, timelines, and resources efficiently.
Build and maintain strong relationships with vendors and partners.
Oversee event setup, execution, and post-event evaluation.
Ensure high levels of client satisfaction and flawless event delivery.
requirements: 2-4 years of experience in event planning or related field.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and organizational skills.
Creative mindset with strong attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple events and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work flexible hours including weekends and holidays.
Bachelor's degree in Event Management, Hospitality, or any related field (preferred).

FAQPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQPage.subtitle: Home / Frequently Asked Questions
FAQPage.faqDescription: Find answers to the most common questions about our event planning services, booking process, and how we make your events unforgettable.

faqsLeft.question: What Types Of Events Do You Plan?
faqsLeft.answer: We plan a wide range of events including weddings, birthday parties, engagements, anniversaries, corporate events, product launches, themed parties, exhibitions, and private celebrations.

faqsLeft.question: How Early Should I Book My Event?
faqsLeft.answer: We recommend booking at least 3-6 months in advance for larger events like weddings and corporate functions, and 1-2 months for smaller parties to ensure date availability and optimal planning time.

faqsLeft.question: Can You Help With Venue Selection?
faqsLeft.answer: Absolutely! We have strong relationships with top venues across the region and can help you find the perfect location that matches your vision, guest count, and budget.

faqsLeft.question: Do You Provide Decoration And Theme Setup?
faqsLeft.answer: Yes, we provide end-to-end decoration services including floral arrangements, lighting, props, and custom theme execution tailored to your specific preferences.

faqsLeft.question: What Is Included In Your Event Planning Package?
faqsLeft.answer: Our comprehensive packages typically include venue sourcing, decor styling, vendor management, on-day coordination, catering arrangements, and detailed itinerary planning.

faqsLeft.question: Do You Handle Catering And Entertainment?
faqsLeft.answer: Yes, we collaborate with premium caterers and top-tier entertainment professionals to provide a seamless and memorable experience for your guests.

faqsRight.question: What Types Of Events Do You Plan?
faqsRight.answer: We plan a wide range of events including weddings, birthday parties, engagements, anniversaries, corporate events, product launches, themed parties, exhibitions, and private celebrations.

faqsRight.question: Can You Customize The Event As Per Our Requirements?
faqsRight.answer: Yes, every event we plan is fully customized. We work closely with you to understand your specific needs, style, and cultural preferences to create a truly personalized experience.

faqsRight.question: Do You Provide A Budget Estimate?
faqsRight.answer: Yes, after our initial consultation, we provide a detailed, transparent budget estimate outlining all expected costs so you can make informed decisions without hidden surprises.

faqsRight.question: How Do You Ensure Everything Runs Smoothly On The Event Day?
faqsRight.answer: We provide a dedicated on-site coordination team that manages vendors, follows the timeline strictly, and handles any unexpected situations so you can relax and enjoy your event.

faqsRight.question: What Is Your Cancellation Or Rescheduling Policy?
faqsRight.answer: Our policies vary depending on the scale of the event and the vendors involved. We outline all cancellation and rescheduling terms clearly in our initial contract for full transparency.

faqsRight.question: How Can I Get A Quote For My Event?
faqsRight.answer: You can easily get a quote by contacting us through our website's contact form, calling our office, or emailing us directly. We'll set up a consultation to discuss your needs.

hero.description: At Viventro, your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, protect, and disclose your information when you use our website and services.

sidebar.title: Your Privacy, Our Priority
sidebar.description: We are committed to protecting your personal information and ensuring a safe and secure experience with Viventro.

policies.title: Information We Collect
policies.description: We collect personal information such as your name, email address, phone number, event details, and any other information you provide through our website or forms.

policies.title: How We Use Your Information
policies.description: We use your information to understand your requirements, provide our services, communicate with you, send updates, and improve our offerings.

policies.title: Information Sharing
policies.description: We do not sell or rent your personal information. We may share your data with trusted service providers who assist us in operating our website and delivering our services, under strict confidentiality.

policies.title: Data Security
policies.description: We implement a variety of security measures to maintain the safety of your personal information. Your data is stored on secure servers and is accessible only to authorized personnel.

policies.title: Cookies
policies.description: Our website uses cookies to enhance your browsing experience. You can choose to disable cookies in your browser settings at any time.

policies.title: Your Rights
policies.description: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information. You can contact us anytime to make a request.

policies.title: Changes To This Policy
policies.description: Viventro may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We encourage you to review this page periodically for any changes.

policies.title: Contact Us
policies.description: If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, feel free to contact us.

helpSection.description: Reach out to our team for any privacy-related questions or assistance.
helpSection.footerText: By using our website and services, you agree to the terms outlined in this Privacy Policy. Thank you for trusting Viventro for your special celebrations.

hero.description: We use cookies to improve your browsing experience and analyse site traffic. This policy explains what cookies we use, why we use them, and how you can control them.

sidebar.title: Your Preferences, Our Respect
sidebar.description: We believe in full transparency. You can manage or withdraw your cookie consent at any time through your browser settings.

policies.title: What Are Cookies?
policies.description: Cookies are small text files placed on your device when you visit our website. They help us remember your preferences and improve your experience on subsequent visits.

policies.title: Types of Cookies We Use
policies.description: We use essential cookies (required for the site to function), performance cookies (to analyse traffic), and functional cookies (to remember your preferences and settings).

policies.title: Essential Cookies
policies.description: These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off. They are usually set in response to actions you take such as logging in or filling out forms.

policies.title: Analytics & Performance Cookies
policies.description: These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve our site's performance. All data collected is aggregated and anonymous.

policies.title: How to Manage Cookies
policies.description: You can set your browser to refuse all or some browser cookies, or to alert you when websites set or access cookies. Disabling cookies may affect some features of our website.

policies.title: Third-Party Cookies
policies.description: In some special cases we also use cookies provided by trusted third parties such as Google Analytics to help us understand how you use our site.

policies.title: Cookie Retention
policies.description: Session cookies expire when you close your browser. Persistent cookies remain on your device for the period specified in the cookie or until you delete them manually.

policies.title: Updates to This Policy
policies.description: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.

helpSection.description: Reach out if you need assistance managing your cookie settings or have questions about our cookie practices.
helpSection.footerText: By continuing to use our website, you consent to our use of cookies as described in this Cookie Policy. Thank you for trusting Viventro.

hero.description: We understand that plans can change. Our refund and cancellation policy is designed to be fair and transparent, ensuring you always know where you stand.

sidebar.title: We Value Your Trust
sidebar.description: Our goal is to make every interaction with Viventro straightforward and stress-free, including our refund and cancellation process.

policies.title: Cancellation by Client
policies.description: If you wish to cancel your event booking, please notify us in writing at least 30 days before the event date. Cancellations made 30+ days prior are eligible for a 70% refund of the total amount paid.

policies.title: Cancellations Within 15–29 Days
policies.description: Cancellations made between 15 and 29 days before the event date are eligible for a 40% refund. The remaining 60% will be retained to cover preparation and vendor commitment costs.

policies.title: Cancellations Within 14 Days
policies.description: Cancellations made within 14 days of the event date are non-refundable. At this stage, significant resources and third-party commitments have already been made on your behalf.

policies.title: Cancellation by Viventro
policies.description: In the unlikely event that Viventro must cancel your booking due to unforeseen circumstances, you will receive a full 100% refund or the option to reschedule at no additional charge.

policies.title: Rescheduling Policy
policies.description: You may reschedule your event once at no additional fee, provided you notify us at least 21 days in advance. Subsequent reschedules may incur an administrative fee of 10%.

policies.title: Refund Processing Time
policies.description: Approved refunds will be processed within 7–10 business days. Refunds will be credited to the original payment method used at the time of booking.

policies.title: Non-Refundable Services
policies.description: Certain customised or third-party services such as venue décor, entertainment bookings, and catering deposits may be non-refundable as per individual vendor agreements.

policies.title: Force Majeure
policies.description: In case of force majeure events (natural disasters, government restrictions, pandemics), Viventro will work with clients to reschedule events or offer partial credits on a case-by-case basis.

helpSection.description: Contact our support team for any refund or cancellation queries. We're committed to resolving all issues promptly and fairly.
helpSection.footerText: This Refund & Cancellation Policy is subject to change. We encourage you to review it before making any bookings. Thank you for choosing Viventro.
